title: Idama Elaphula Ubukumkani
intro: Ilizwe elinemilambo equkuqelayo, iigadi ezimbini eziluhlaza, kunye nobutyebi obungenakuthelekiswa nanto—kodwa abemi balo abazange bamnanze Lowo wabasikelelayo. Xa izikhumbuzo zifika zibabiza, bajika. Okwalandela yayiluhlwayo olusavakala njengesilumkiso. Yayingoobani olu luntu lwamandulo?
clues: Sasihlala kwilizwe elibusisekileyo kangangokuba ikhaya lethu laliphakathi kweegadi ezimbini eziluhlaza.
Sasinandipha imilambo equkuqela imihlaba yethu kunye nesivuno esikhulu esizalisa amakhaya ethu.
Kodwa xa sabizwa ukuba sibulele kwaye sithobele iNkosi yethu, sajika ngekratshi.
Ubutyebi bethu kunye nokulula kwethu kwasenza samlibala Lowo wasinika konke.
Emva koko kwafika imvula enkulu ngequbuliso eyagqobhoza umqobo omkhulu esasithembele kuwo.
Singabantu baseSaba', ilizwe labo lalisaziwa ngeDama elikhulu laseMa'rib.

outcome.label: Isiphelo Sethu
options: Iigadi ezimbini ezikrakra zathatha indawo yezo zethu ziluhlaza
Iigadi zethu zikhule zanezityalo ezichumileyo ngakumbi
Isizwe sethu sahlulwe saba zizizwe ezilishumi elinambini
outcome.answer: Iigadi ezimbini ezikrakra zathatha indawo yezo zethu ziluhlaza

arabic: فَأَعْرَضُوا۟ فَأَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَيْلَ ٱلْعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلْنَـٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيْهِمْ جَنَّتَيْنِ ذَوَاتَىْ أُكُلٍ خَمْطٍۢ وَأَثْلٍۢ وَشَىْءٍۢ مِّن سِدْرٍۢ قَلِيلٍۢ
verse: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees. (34:16)
